## Outcome / acceptance criteria

## Exact scope
- Implementer / task branch:
- Baseline Site version / source SHA:
- Data sources or access changed: none / explain

## Evidence
- [ ] Regression tests for changed behaviour
- [ ] TypeScript passed
- [ ] Existing CI tests and production build passed
- [ ] No credentials, runtime data exports or generated state in diff
- [ ] Missing values, original dates and source priority preserved
- [ ] Desktop/mobile QA if UI changed (otherwise N/A)
- [ ] Independent review (name/link), or explicitly state not yet performed

## Release / recovery
- GitHub commit:
- Published Site version + source commit (fill after deployment):
- Post-release `/api/health` result compared with baseline:
- Previous known-good Site version for rollback:
- Remaining failures / next owner:

Do not equate passing tests, a published page or persisted=true with complete source coverage.
